description_en: Resets cloud computers within a shared cloud computer
description_zh: 重置共享型云电脑内的云电脑
name: ResetDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The shared cloud computer ID.

If DesktopId is specified, DesktopGroupId is ignored.
If DesktopId is empty, the system retrieves the DesktopId of all cloud computers within the shared cloud computer based on DesktopGroupId
parameters.help_zh:
共享型云电脑ID。

如果传入了`DesktopId`，则忽略该`DesktopGroupId`。
如果`DesktopId`为空，则会根据`DesktopGroupId`去获取该共享型云电脑内所有云电脑的`DesktopId`
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method.
This parameter takes effect only for resetting shared cloud computers. If this parameter is left empty, all cloud computers of all billing methods within the shared cloud computer are reset
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。
仅对重置共享型云电脑有效，为空则重置共享型云电脑下所有付费类型的云电脑
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The reset type, which determines whether to reset and the scope of cloud disks to reset
parameters.help_zh: 重置类型，决定是否重置，以及要重置的磁盘范围
parameters.name: reset_type

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云电脑 ID 列表。可设置 1~100 个
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑 ID 列表
parameters.name: desktop_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The reset scope. You can configure this parameter to specify whether to reset the image or the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 重置范围，可以通过配置参数来设置是重置镜像还是重置云电脑
parameters.name: reset_scope

parameters.help_en: The timestamp of the last retry. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 上次重试的时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: last_retry_time
